_comment: Search parameters. Edited by hand — no code changes needed.
candidate: Ananya Saini — junior product/UX designer, ~1.5 yrs, Nagpur-based
_note_freshness: Only postings from the last max_job_age_days are shown. Older than that and the role is usually filled or the pipeline is cold, so the application is wasted effort. Postings with no readable date are kept — a live careers page is presumed current — but they are counted separately so the ratio stays visible.
_note_geo: Two separate rules. ONSITE/HYBRID roles must be in one of her four cities. REMOTE roles are accepted from anywhere in the world, unless the posting restricts itself to a region she cannot work from (US-only, Canada-only, EMEA-only, and so on). A remote role in a city she has excluded is still fine — she would not be relocating.
_note_remote_restricted: A remote posting naming ONLY one of these is out of reach — she has no work authorisation there. It is kept if it also says worldwide/global/anywhere/India.
_note_onsite_excluded: Indian cities she will not relocate to. Applies to onsite/hybrid roles only — a remote role listed against these cities is still acceptable.
_note_seniority: HARD RULE: she has ~1.5 years total. A posting is eligible only if its requirement tops out at 3 years. '3+ years' is NOT acceptable — the plus makes it open-ended above 3. '3 years', '1-3 years', '2-3 years', '0-2 years' and fresher all are.
